articles.title: Netanyahu defends Israeli military action as delegates walk out before UN speech
articles.description: The Israeli leader labels those who left his speech at the UN General Assembly as "moral cowards".

articles.title: Four civilians killed in Pakistani strikes in Afghanistan, Taliban says
articles.description: Pakistan says it struck 10 targets, adding the strikes were "strictly limited to identified military objectives".

articles.title: Priest killed and four injured in knife attack at Polish abbey
articles.description: A male suspect from Ukraine was arrested after the stabbings in the town of Jarosław, police say.

articles.title: Ethiopia's army says it has repelled attacks in first comment on fresh fighting
articles.description: The military says its soldiers inflicted casualties as fears grow of a resumption of a full-blown civil war.

articles.title: Poland says fire at Starlink station is sabotage as Denmark warns of rising Russian threat
articles.description: The satellite station is used in part to provide internet coverage to neighbouring Ukraine, the government says.

articles.title: Why India's Election Commission is in the eye of a storm - again
articles.description: India's polling monitor is facing yet another crisis of credibility with fresh allegations against its chief.

articles.title: Russia could attack a NATO country within months, Danish intelligence warns
articles.description: Danish intelligence has warned that Moscow could launch a limited military attack in the coming months against a NATO country that borders Russia.

articles.title: UK condemns Tigray attacks in Ethiopia - four years after civil war
articles.description: The UK has condemned attacks by Tigray forces across Ethiopia's northern region this week, with fears that another civil war could break out.

articles.title: Premier League in joint call for FIFA reform amid Infantino crisis
articles.description: The Premier League and three of its top European counterparts will on Friday issue a joint call for urgent governance reform at FIFA amid the crisis engulfing its president, Gianni Infantino.
